name: request-guard
description: Counts and spaces every request a session or subagent sends to a public website: a PreToolUse hook on Bash, PowerShell, WebFetch and browser navigation refuses loops, bursts, unreadable targets and invented identifiers and waits for a site's turn; PostToolUse on WebFetch starts a back-off when a site answers 403, 429 or 503. One ledger per machine. Includes a paced fetcher for batches and the fetch-paced skill.
